notes.title: EVENT / UPDATE / KEYS
notes.content:
HALLO C-WARLERS


Tomorrow at 7 p.m. (Pacific time) we will start the first Twitch event in the key fight game that you can. The admins are waiting for you. More information will follow tomorrow.


Today was a successful day for me. I hope you feel the same way ... I've thought a lot about how to create objects in real time without lag. I already uploaded an update for tomorrow's main update. Simply for a better gaming behavior. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35106298/196f34d5dddcc744b6694994ff1446bc457b906a.png

IN THIS UPDATE:
- UI revision
- LAG compensation
- When you run through an ammo box with a weapon, the ammo box placed by the player is added to 
   the reload ammo. If you walk trough with the handgun, it will pick up ammunition that ends up in 
   your inventory as a new ammunition box.  So you can hold it or drop it again.



if you notice any mistakes or anything else, please let me know. Everything relevant like the train, place of tower, sky lift, loot, etc. should work now.


Cheers Dave

notes.title: LEVEL ONE RACHED
notes.content:
HALLO PLAYERS


Thank you for all the players who play this game. First I would like to apologize for the mistake that you haven't seen each other anymore.


Why is the world in night?
i always liked the tactical approach in the dark. So you have to work with the light and take good care of buildings that have lights.

IN THIS UPDATE:

I have now reached the status to say that 95 percent of the time everything is working properly.
- I changed the input for the flashlight to the button F and the powerups to X.
- A complete overhaul of the drone.
- in addition to writing with the entire room, you can now leave notes in any place to confuse or inform 
  players.
- Droped Items are now stacking it by self.
- Added visual effects for wepons.

WORKING ON:
- Quest/Tasks
- Better Light
- More Frames
- Lie down (upgrade to Crouch)
- Snowmobile
- Completely animate opponents

notes.title: TRAIN / SNOW LIFT / BUGS
notes.content:
HALLO DEAR COMMUNITY

this time i fixed a lot of bugs and improved a lot. I still have to understand why the frames in the main menu and the GPU are so high. In the main game this should be the same, which unfortunately is not the case yet. This means if everything works as it should, there are optimized frame numbers for the next update and FPS settings for the menu.

FIXED:
Train is working now
Snowlift 100%
The body and the arms are rotating like it must be in snowlift

TODO:
FPS Settings in main menu
More Frames on main map
Trees to ground



So let me know when something went wrong that helps alot.


Cheers David

notes.title: C-WAR 2 UPDATE
notes.content:
First of all 

merry christmas


I have now taken care of this update for 1.5 years. Tomorrow I will tell you the details of what everything has changed.


Cheers David and Friends
Have Fun

notes.title: New update!
notes.content:
Hi gamers:

This week's update opens up the skies! Introducing the all new Hot Air Balloon! In this craft you will be able to get around the map quickly and in a future update you will also be able to use it as a mobile sniping platform.

I also fixed some bugs:

- Day-Night-Cycle works properly now.
- Night vision goggles now work after first depletion.
- The correct weapon is shown over the network.
- Your coins are saved correctly after you leave a room.

The in-game shop now allows you to buy the DLC with the in-game currency.

Have fun!

notes.title: PLAY 4 FREE
notes.content:
C-WAR 2 is now free to play on steam!

Update log:

- Weapons have been integrated as loot.

- Find your friends by their server number and join them.

- Many bug fixes.
